entities.name: South West Pacific theater of World War II
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The South West Pacific theatre, during World War II, was a major theatre of the war between the Allies and the Axis. It included the Philippines, the Dutch East Indies, Borneo, Australia, its mandate Territory of New Guinea and the Solomon Islands' western part. This area was defined by the Allied powers' South West Pacific Area (SWPA) command.
